intro: Handfuls of Oats are simple grains salvaged from the abandoned farmsteads of Westfall. They serve as essential feed for working livestock like Old Blanchy, who struggle under the weight of refugee travel.

p: Once the breadbasket of the Kingdom of Stormwind, Westfall's vast agrarian plots now lie overgrown or overrun by Defias bandits and rogue harvest golems. Despite the collapse of order, sacks of cultivated grain and oats remain abandoned near outbuildings, barns, and overgrown plots. For travelers and refugees stranded by broken wagons along the dusty roads, recovering handfuls of these leftover oats is one of the few ways to nourish weary draft horses.
